identitySignals: The agenda names 'ISI Inspection Services, Inc., Berkeley, CA' for materials testing and special inspection. The company's own site is Inspection Services, Inc. (ISI), a special inspection and materials testing firm with its office at 1798 University Avenue, Berkeley, CA.

The services match OUSD's contract titles: DSA (Division of the State Architect) certified project inspectors and materials testing at school sites. The website says ISI has worked on several hundred K-12 and college construction projects.

Public special-inspection agency lists from the City of Oakland, Berkeley, San Jose and Sonoma County show 'Inspection Services, Inc.' at 1798 University Avenue, Berkeley, with phone (510) 900-2100. This matches the website contact page.
research.notes: The agenda spells the name 'ISI Inspection Services, Inc.', while the company's website and public agency lists use 'Inspection Services, Inc.' (ISI). I did not confirm the exact registered legal name in the California Secretary of State records, so the legal name comes from the website. I did not find the California entity number, EIN or SAM UEI. EIN does not apply to a for-profit company. The email shown on the contact page is a marketing inbox (isimarketing@), not a general info@ address. Some directory listings show a Torrance office, but Berkeley is the headquarters on the company's contact page.

profile.summary: Inspection Services, Inc. (ISI) is a woman-owned small business founded in 1995. It provides quality assurance, quality control, special inspection and construction materials testing for new construction and retrofit projects. Its clients include public agencies, schools, hospitals and private builders, mostly in California.

review.notes: I confirmed that the profile describes the Berkeley firm OUSD contracts with, Inspection Services, Inc. (ISI). Its website lists the address, phone and email at 1798 University Avenue, Berkeley, and says it does special inspection and materials testing on K-12 school projects, which matches OUSD's DSA inspection agreements. The About and Home pages support the neutral summary: a woman-owned small business founded in 1995 that does QA/QC, special inspection and materials testing for public, school, hospital and private projects in California. The isimarketing@ address is a general business inbox, not a named person's email.
